name: Taishi (Osaka, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Taishi town emblem in white: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Taishi, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 October 1963.

features.role: Taishi town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character
